title: aconogonon molle var. rude
intro: Aconogonon molle var. rude, commonly known as the Chinese gentian, is a plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate pain, reduce swelling, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Aconogonon molle var. rude include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, such as gentiogenin and gentiopicroside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
